fields.label: Learner feedback campaign
fields.help_text: The campaign this record is one face of. Sibling records share it and differ only by EPA.

fields.label: Teaching contexts that responded
fields.help_text: How many distinct teaching contexts the returned questionnaires came from. EPA 15 asks for feedback across at least two; this is reported, not enforced.

fields.help_text: The narrative already released to the trainee. No learner is named and no individual comment is reproduced here.
